en-US.description: A desktop AI companion that connects any model, does the work itself, and delegates specialist jobs to coding agents.
en-US.longDescription:
Nomi is an AI companion living on your desktop: bring any model, let it do the work, and let it hand specialist jobs to specialist AIs. Models, coding agents, MCP and local tools all connect in one place, coordinated by Nomi.
Connect a model once and every AI can use it: after adding a provider, Nomi itself plus Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok and dsh can use any of its models, or everything can switch to local models. The local gateway detects and translates between Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions and Gemini generateContent, so streaming, tool calls, reasoning, images and context compaction keep working.
Tasks can be limited to specific folders, coding assistants get a two-column workspace, and the desktop mascot shows speech and confirmation bubbles. The app runs on a Go core with the native WebView, installs per user without administrator rights, and needs the Edge WebView2 runtime, which is usually preinstalled on Windows 10 and 11.

zh-CN.description: 桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己干活，也能把专业的活派给编程助手。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Nomi 是住在你桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己动手干活，也会把专业的活派给专业的 AI。模型、编程助手、MCP 与本地工具都接到一处，由 Nomi 统一调度。
模型只接一次就能给所有 AI 使用：添加一次供应商，Nomi 自己和 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok、dsh 都能用它的任意模型，也可以全部换成本地模型。本机网关自动识别并互转 Anthropic Messages、OpenAI Responses、OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Gemini generateContent，流式、工具调用、推理、图片和上下文压缩都照常工作。
任务可以限定能访问的文件夹，编程助手有独立的两栏工作区，桌面角色会显示台词与确认气泡。应用为 Go 内核加原生 WebView，单个安装包约 39 MB，按当前用户安装，不需要管理员权限。
zh-CN.name: Nomi
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Nomi· 诺米 2.3.12
工作台不再分「对话 / 工坊」，装了编程助手就一直显示相关界面。
- 侧栏顶行改成铺满的「新建会话」；左下角只留「设置」，知识和扩展仍可从输入栏菜单或快捷键打开。
- Gemini 不再提供 Google 账号登录。来源只剩终端里 ~/.gemini 的配置，或第三方供应商。升级时会删除 Nomi 里保存的 Gemini 账号和登录凭据，不改终端里的 ~/.gemini。
- Computer Use 的禁用应用规则更严：按应用名操作、截屏或视觉定位时也会避开禁用的应用；紧急停止能中止已跑一段时间的那一轮。
- 预览区 Diff 标签里没保存的编辑，切到别的标签再回来还在；关掉要先确认。首次从命令面板「新建任务」会弹出创建表单。
细节
- 「沿用终端里的代理」只放在「设置 → 编程助手 → 通用」，各账号里不再各显示一份。
- 图标按钮不再弹出系统悬停提示，名字改由无障碍标签提供；被截断的文件名和路径仍可看全文。
- 界面里的「智能体」改为 Agents。
English
The workbench is no longer split into Chat and Workshop; coding-agent UI stays visible once those tools are installed.
- The sidebar top row is a full-width New chat button; only Settings remains at the bottom left. Knowledge and Extensions still open from the composer menu or shortcuts.
- Gemini no longer offers Google account sign-in. The only sources are your local ~/.gemini config or a third-party provider. Upgrading deletes Gemini accounts and credentials saved in Nomi; it does not change ~/.gemini in your terminal.
- Computer Use app-block rules also apply when operating by app name, and screenshots or visual targeting skip blocked apps that are visible; the emergency stop also cancels a turn that has already been running.
- Unsaved edits in a Diff preview tab are kept when you switch tabs, and closing the tab asks first. The first "New task" from the command palette opens the create form.
Details
- "Use the terminal proxy" now lives only under Settings → Coding agents → General, not on each official-account page.
- Icon buttons no longer show native tooltips; their names come from accessibility labels. Truncated file names and paths still show the full text.
- The in-app word 智能体 is now Agents.
